answer: Proof of Stake acts as the summit of Sybil resistance for AI economies by requiring agents to lock capital in a secure vault. By tying consensus weight to an onyx ledger of staked assets, the protocol makes identity forgery economically irrational. An attacker must acquire a prohibitive percentage of total supply to manipulate the network, as the cost of capital deployment outweighs any potential gain from subverting the decentralized consensus.
